purpose: Say that appearance strongly fits an expected image.
keywords: いかにも + description; いかにも … そうだ
He has hands that look every bit a craftsman’s.
formation: いかにも + description; いかにも … そうだ
mistake: An appearance is not proof; そうだ preserves that distinction.
